name: Sips garri
description: Grinning Pepe sipping from a mug, caption 'Sips Garri.' Sitting with popcorn/garri watching the drama unfold.
whenToUse: When gossip, wahala, or a long story is happening and you are just watching: 'I dey look', 'continue', 'this one sweet', popcorn energy. Also after a spicy take you will not jump into. Calm spectator, not the fighter.
whenNotToUse: Skip if they need help, a decision, or empathy. Not for greetings or serious distress.
